sourceNote: Printed page 12: a full-page map titled “ظہورِ اسلام کے وقت ملکِ عرب کے قبائل” showing the tribes of Arabia in very small and blurred writing and an arrow towards the north. It is redrawn here only as a schematic outline with the legible names (ملکِ فارس, بحرِ احمر, الربع الخالی, حضرموت, یمن, عمان, بحرِ عرب, الحبش); the individual tribe names inside the map are illegible and are not reproduced. English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1.
